about.desc: IndexTTS-Server is an open-source pure C++ ONNX Runtime (zero-Python) IndexTTS 1.5 voice cloning server and native Windows WPF desktop console. Supports INT4+FP16 lightweight weights (~923 MB zip) as well as FP16 weights, exposing standard OpenAI-compatible (/v1/audio/speech, /v1/audio/voices) and native HTTP APIs.
about.license_body:
• C++ inference server and WPF desktop source code are licensed under the Apache License 2.0.
• Upstream model credit: index-tts/index-tts (IndexTTS 1.5); model weights follow their respective upstream license.
• No model weights or personal audio files are included in this repository.
